summary.text: Patrick Leahy is a nonpartisan candidate for the Nebraska Legislature, District 6, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a former member of the Papio-Missouri River Natural Resources District Board and, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as the CEO of First Star Recycling and an Army Reserve officer.

paragraphs.text: Patrick Leahy advanced from the May 12, 2026 primary for District 6 and faces Nate Ostdiek in a race with no incumbent.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Leahy said he previously raised money for schools, churches and nonprofits in Omaha, and that as a director of the Papio-Missouri River Natural Resources District Board he helped cut the property tax rate three times.
He listed lowering property taxes, delivering affordable childcare and addressing Nebraska's workforce shortage as the key messages of his campaign.
Leahy also said that, because of his Army Reserve background, he is concerned about recent cuts to veterans aid.
